title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Skill-chip search on the four confirmed IDs, plus a title-skim of the unfiltered Engineering feed for Platform Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer (no confirmed chip exists for either). Scores measure technical and domain fit only.
latest_update: Re-run September 21, 2026 — identical outcome to the 2026-09-19 run: all four confirmed skill-chip searches return zero results, and the same TaskRabbit posting (now Applied) and the same US-only ineligible posting remain the only two topically relevant listings on the unfiltered feed.

rows.title: Sr Software Engineer - Developer Productivity
rows.location: United States | Canada + 2 more — explicitly Canada-eligible
rows.gap: Skill fit itself is strong (CI/CD, ArgoCD/GitOps, Kubernetes/Docker/Helm, developer-platform ownership, and explicit day-to-day use of Claude/AI-assisted workflows — directly supported by Marc's real AI-assisted-engineering practice at Énergir), but the $60–70/hr rate is well below the profile's $100/hr full-time-consulting-contract floor for this 40hrs/wk, long-term engagement — capped per the rate red flag rather than the skill gap.

notes_sections.heading: Keyword results
items: All four confirmed skill-chip IDs returned zero results this run, same as 2026-09-19: DevOps Engineer (1338), Site Reliability Engineer (8473), Cloud Engineer / Cloud Engineering (10001), DevSecOps Engineer (6831).

Platform Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer still have no confirmed skill chip. Fell back to the unfiltered role=5,16 listing (1,394 total openings, sorted by recency) and title-skimmed the first page (~20 postings).

The unfiltered feed's relevance density remains very low — dominated by unrelated freelance gigs (LATAM Salesforce/CMS/QA roles, CNC programming, iOS, LLM data annotation, AI benchmarking) rather than infrastructure/DevOps work. Only the same 2 postings from the prior run were topically adjacent: the TaskRabbit role (now Applied, carried forward from applications.md) and the same US-only DevOps Cloud Engineer posting (ineligible, pre-review location gate — not reopened).

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: Second run against this source; confirms the 2026-09-19 finding rather than surfacing anything new — Braintrust currently has very little SRE/Platform/DevOps-specific demand for the target titles.
Browser-driven throughout, per the skill's requirement (client-side rendered, direct HTTP returns an empty shell).
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, or write-side action occurred; no account created or profile submitted.
Checked applications.md fresh this run: TaskRabbit (https://app.usebraintrust.com/jobs/17859/) is Applied — 2026-09-19. Status carried forward, not re-scored.
